content_sections.heading: Subarnapur District Yoga Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Subarnapur District Yoga Teacher Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Subarnapur District Yoga Teacher Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Yoga Teacher post in Subarnapur District?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Yoga Teacher post in Subarnapur District is scheduled for 30th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue with all necessary documents on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Yoga Teacher position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies for the Yoga Teacher position in Subarnapur District Recruitment 2026. This provides a good number of opportunities for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Yoga Teacher post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for the Yoga Teacher post is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 50 years. Candidates falling within this age range are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Yoga Teacher role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a PG Diploma in Yoga, MA in human conscious & Yogic science, MA in Yoga & Naturopathy, MA in Yogic Science, a Diploma or Certificate Course in Yoga, or +2 with 140 hrs of yoga training.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Subarnapur District Yoga Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Subarnapur District Yoga Teacher recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Yoga Teacher position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Yoga Teacher position is Rs. 500 per session, with each session lasting 90 minutes. This is a part-time role.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Subarnapur District Yoga Teacher recruitment involves Registration, Shortlisting, and Personality Assessment. Candidates will be evaluated based on these stages.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates if any, category certificate if applicable), and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a full-time or part-time job?
faq.answer: The Yoga Teacher position in Subarnapur District is a part-time job. The salary structure is based on per session, indicating a flexible working arrangement.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and more details?
faq.answer: The official notification and further details can be found on the official website of Subarnapur District, www.subarnapur.odisha.gov.in. Links to the notification and website are provided in the 'Important Links' section.
